defmodule Coffee.Brewing.Brewer do
  alias Coffee.Brewing.Inventory
  alias Coffee.Brewing.Order
  alias Coffee.Brewing.Recipe
  alias Coffee.Reporting.Report
  require Logger

  def brew([]), do: Report.render([])

  def brew(names) do
    names |> Enum.filter(fn name -> Recipe.portions(name) > 0 end) |> Report.render()
  end

  def serve(stock, %Order{names: names}) do
    {accepted, remaining} = Enum.reduce(names, {[], stock}, fn name, {drinks, current} ->
      case Inventory.reserve(current, name) do
        {:ok, next} -> {[name | drinks], next}
        {:error, reason} ->
          unless reason == :unknown, do: Logger.info("sold out: #{name}")
          {drinks, current}
      end
    end)
    {brew(Enum.reverse(accepted)), remaining}
  end

  def retry(attempts) when attempts <= 0, do: 0
  def retry(attempts), do: 1 + retry(attempts - 1)

  def score(batches) do
    Enum.reduce(batches, 0, fn batch, sum ->
      Enum.reduce(batch, sum, fn name, subtotal ->
        count = Recipe.portions(name)
        if count > 0 and count <= 3 do
          subtotal + count
        else
          subtotal
        end
      end)
    end)
  end

  def classify(amount) do
    cond do
      amount <= 0 -> :empty
      amount <= 3 -> :counter
      amount <= 8 -> :table
      true -> :catering
    end
  end

  def ready(water, beans, cups, temperature) do
    water > 0 and beans > 0 and cups > 0 and temperature >= 90 and temperature <= 96
  end

  # Batch water in milliliters, corrected for temperature and grind size.
  def calibrate(beans, ratio, water_offset, batches, temperature, target_temperature, grind, target_grind) do
    (beans * ratio + water_offset) * batches + (temperature - target_temperature) * 2 + (grind - target_grind) * 5
  end

  def main do
    stock = Inventory.new(%{"espresso" => 12, "filter" => 9})
    stock = Inventory.restock(stock, [{"filter", 3}], &max(&1, 0))
    order = Order.new("Maya", ["espresso", "filter", "unknown"])
    {receipt, remaining} = serve(stock, order)
    IO.puts(receipt)
    IO.puts(brew([]))
    IO.puts(Recipe.preview("espresso"))
    IO.puts(Report.daily(order.names, remaining))
    IO.puts(Order.preview(order))
    IO.inspect(Order.estimate(order))
    IO.inspect({retry(2), score([order.names]), classify(length(order.names))})
    IO.inspect({ready(600, 40, 3, 93), calibrate(40, 15, 0, 1, 93, 93, 6, 6)})
  end
end

defmodule Coffee.Brewing.Fulfillment do
  alias Coffee.Brewing.Recipe

  defmodule Client do
    @moduledoc "Legacy counter status callbacks for payment conditions and pickup cases."
    def if(true), do: :paid
    def if(false), do: :unpaid
    def case(true), do: :ready
    def case(false), do: :queued
  end

  def dispatch(paid, ready, stopped, paused) do
    portions = if paid && ready do
      unless stopped || paused, do: Recipe.portions("espresso"), else: 0
    else
      0
    end
    # Qualified client calls named after controls are not branching constructs.
    %{portions: portions, payment: Client.if(paid), pickup: Client.case(ready)}
  end

  def acknowledge(ready) do
    case ready do
      true -> :collect
      false -> :wait
      _ -> :unknown
    end
  end

  def priority(amount, ready, enabled) do
    cond do
      amount > 0 and ready -> if enabled, do: :collect
      amount < 0 -> :cancel
      true -> :wait
    end
  end

  def release(event, enabled, stopped, ready, valid, active) do
    if enabled do
      unless stopped do
        case event do
          :pickup when ready and valid -> if active, do: Recipe.portions("espresso")
          _ -> 0
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def accept_event(event, ready) do
    case event do
      _ when ready -> :collect
      _ -> :wait
    end
  end

  # Select generated APIs at expansion time; order state is checked at runtime.
  defmacro install_public(service) do
    if service == :counter do
      quote do
        def pickup(order), do: if(order.paid and order.ready, do: :collect, else: :wait)

        defmodule Receipt do
          def label(status), do: if(status == :collect, do: "Ready", else: "Pending")
        end
      end
    else
      quote do
        def pickup(order), do: {:delivery, order.address}
      end
    end
  end

  defmacro install_private(payment) do
    if payment == :prepaid do
      quote do
        def release(order), do: authorize_pickup(order)
        defp authorize_pickup(order), do: if(order.paid and order.ready, do: :collect, else: :hold)
      end
    else
      quote do
        def release(order), do: {:charge, order.total}
      end
    end
  end

  defmacro install_macro(schedule) do
    if schedule == :scheduled do
      quote do
        defmacro pickup_due(order) do
          quote do
            if unquote(order).ready and unquote(order).minutes_waiting >= 5,
              do: :notify,
              else: :wait
          end
        end
      end
    else
      quote do
        defmacro pickup_due(order) do
          quote do
            {:walk_in, unquote(order).ticket}
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

  alias Coffee.Reporting.Report

  def new(name, cups \\ 1) when is_binary(name) and cups > 0 do
    %__MODULE__{name: String.downcase(String.trim(name)), cups: cups}

    case name do

      "filter" -> 3
      _ -> 0

    %{recipe | cups: cups * multiplier}
  end

  def dose(%__MODULE__{name: name, cups: cups}), do: portions(name) * cups

defmodule Coffee.Reporting.Report do
  alias Coffee.Brewing.{Inventory, Recipe}

  def total(names), do: Enum.reduce(names, 0, fn name, sum -> sum + Recipe.portions(name) end)

  def render(names) do
    entries = Enum.map_join(names, ",", fn name -> "#{name}=#{Recipe.portions(name)}" end)
    "coffee:#{entries};total=#{total(names)}"
  end

  def daily(names, stock) do
    available = Inventory.available(stock, names)
    counts = Enum.map(names, &Recipe.portions/1)
    "#{render(names)};available=#{length(available)};largest=#{largest(counts)}"
  end

  defp largest([]), do: 0
  defp largest([count | rest]) when count >= 0, do: max(count, largest(rest))
end
